audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The driver imports the infinite-valued introduction, Łukasiewicz, and Gödel sections and has olchapter id inf, but its source header names three-valued-logics.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மொழிபெயர்ப்பின் கோப்பு மேல்தகவல் அதன் உண்மையான முடிவிலா மதிப்புத் தருக்கங்கள் அதிகாரத்தைப் பெயரிடுகிறது.

audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected header now agree with the stable inf chapter id and imported files?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the numerator bound in V_m from n less than or equal to m to n less than m.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: With denominator m-1, the source condition n less than or equal to m produces m+1 values and includes m/(m-1), which is above 1; the next line says V_5 has five evenly spaced values and lists numerators 0 through 4.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் $n<m$ என்ற வரம்பைப் பயன்படுத்தி $V_m$ இல் சரியாக $m$ மதிப்புகளையும் அவை அனைத்தும் $[0,1]$ இலும் இருப்பதையும் உறுதிசெய்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the denominator to m; retaining the above-one endpoint; using n less than or equal to m-1.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: For natural numbers beginning at zero, n<m and n less than or equal to m-1 are equivalent; n<m is concise and exactly reproduces the displayed V_5 example.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the repaired comprehension yield exactly the m equally spaced points 0, 1/(m-1), through 1?
